name: List tables
description: All user tables in the database.
body:
SELECT name AS table_name
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
ORDER BY name;

name: Row count for a table
description: Exact number of rows in a chosen table.

name: List indexes
description: All indexes and the table they belong to.
body:
SELECT name AS index_name, tbl_name AS table_name
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type = 'index'
ORDER BY tbl_name, name;

name: Column overview for a table
description: Columns, types and nullability for a given table.
